title: Digital Project & Operations Manager:in (m/w/d)
description: Vino Digital ist die E-Commerce-Agentur für die Weinbranche und ein Geschäftsbereich der TAFKA GmbH. Wir entwickeln für familiengeführte Weingüter Shops, Content, Kampagnen und digitale Systeme, die im Alltag funktionieren und messbare Ergebnisse liefern. Im zweiten Geschäftsbereich TAFKA helfen wir Unternehmen, KI und Automatisierung praktisch in ihre Arbeit zu integrieren. Für unser Team suchen wir eine berufserfahrene Person, die digitale Projekte eigenständig führt, technische Themen sicher einordnet und bei Bedarf direkt in die Umsetzung geht. An einem Tag steuerst du ein Kundenprojekt, am nächsten löst du ein Problem mit Shop, DNS oder Tracking, schneidest ein Video in DaVinci Resolve oder entwickelst mit Claude und Codex einen besseren Workflow. Du arbeitest eng mit unserem Team und der Geschäftsführung zusammen. Du bringst Ordnung in komplexe Situationen, kommunizierst klar und führst Projekte zuverlässig zum Ergebnis. Wenn du Verantwortung magst, digitale Systeme schnell verstehst und einen vielseitigen Arbeitsalltag suchst, sollten wir uns kennenlernen. Aufgaben Digitale Projekte führen: Du übernimmst Vino-Digital-Projekte von der Planung bis zum Abschluss, setzt Prioritäten, koordinierst Beteiligte und hältst Zeit, Qualität und nächste Schritte im Blick. Kunden sicher begleiten: Du bist zentrale Ansprechperson für ausgewählte Partnerweingüter, führst Termine, übersetzt Ziele in klare Arbeitspakete und löst Probleme proaktiv. Systeme weiterentwickeln: Du sammelst wiederkehrende Anforderungen, priorisierst Verbesserungen, formulierst saubere Briefings für Entwicklung und Automatisierung, testest neue Funktionen und dokumentierst den fertigen Prozess. Technische Themen lösen: Du arbeitest sicher mit CMS, Domains, DNS-Einträgen, Formularen, Tracking und Integrationen. Bei Fehlern grenzt du die Ursache systematisch ein und organisierst eine belastbare Lösung. Web und E-Commerce umsetzen: Du pflegst und verbesserst Seiten in Shopify, WordPress oder vergleichbaren Systemen und kannst kleinere Anpassungen selbst durchführen. Videos produzieren: Du schneidest Social-, Performance-, Schulungs- und Kunden-Videos in DaVinci Resolve, inklusive Auswahl, Dramaturgie, Ton, Untertiteln und passenden Exportformaten. AI-first arbeiten: Du nutzt Claude und Codex täglich für Planung, Recherche, Dokumentation, Troubleshooting, Text, Prototyping und kleine technische Umsetzungen. Ergebnisse prüfst und verbesserst du eigenständig. TAFKA unterstützen: Je nach Auslastung übernimmst du passende Aufgaben in KI-, Automatisierungs- oder Content-Projekten von TAFKA, etwa Projektkoordination, Prototyping, Video-Deliverables oder Qualitätssicherung. Standards verbessern: Du erkennst wiederkehrende Reibung, entwickelst Vorlagen und Prozesse weiter und sorgst dafür, dass gute Lösungen im Team wiederverwendbar werden. Qualifikation Du bringst mindestens drei Jahre relevante Berufserfahrung in einer Agentur, einem Digitalunternehmen, einem E-Commerce-Team, einem Start-up oder einem vergleichbaren Umfeld mit. Du hast mehrere digitale Projekte mit eigener Kunden- oder Stakeholder-Verantwortung geführt und kannst konkret erklären, welche schwierigen Situationen du gelöst und welche Ergebnisse du erreicht hast. Du kommunizierst verbindlich, priorisierst klar und bleibst handlungsfähig, wenn Anforderungen unvollständig sind oder kurz vor einem Termin ein Problem auftaucht. Du verstehst die Grundlagen von Domains und DNS. Begriffe wie A-Record, CNAME, MX und TXT sind dir vertraut. Du hast bereits eine Website oder einen Shop mit WordPress, Shopify, Webflow oder einem vergleichbaren CMS umgesetzt oder wesentlich weiterentwickelt. Du hast praktische Schnitt-Erfahrung mit DaVinci Resolve und kannst Arbeitsproben zeigen. Grundlagen bei Ton, Farbe, Untertiteln und Social-Formaten sitzen. Du nutzt Claude, Codex oder vergleichbare KI-Werkzeuge routiniert und kannst zeigen, wie du damit Qualität, Tempo oder Problemlösung verbessert hast. Du dokumentierst Entscheidungen und Prozesse so, dass andere damit weiterarbeiten können. Du arbeitest auf Deutsch mindestens auf C1-Niveau und kannst dich im beruflichen Alltag auf Englisch verständigen. Du kannst regelmäßig in unserem Büro nahe Ostkreuz in Berlin arbeiten: 3 Tage pro Woche Ein Studium ist keine Voraussetzung. Entscheidend sind deine Berufspraxis, dein Urteilsvermögen und die Ergebnisse, für die du bereits Verantwortung getragen hast. Erfahrung mit Vibe Coding, APIs, Webhooks oder Automationen ist willkommen. Benefits Echte Verantwortung: Du führst eigene Projekte und hast direkten Einfluss auf Kunden, Abläufe und Produktqualität. Abwechslungsreiche Arbeit mit erkennbarem Kern: Projektmanagement bildet deine Basis. Technik, Systeme, Video und KI geben dir Raum, weitere Stärken einzusetzen. Zwei spannende Arbeitsfelder: Du arbeitest überwiegend für Vino Digital und kannst dich zusätzlich in ausgewählte KI- und Automatisierungsprojekte von TAFKA einbringen. AI-first-Umfeld: Claude, Codex und moderne Automatisierungswerkzeuge gehören zu unserem Arbeitsalltag. Gute Experimente können schnell zum neuen Standard werden. Kurze Entscheidungswege: Du arbeitest direkt mit dem Team und der Geschäftsführung und kannst Verbesserungen selbst anstoßen. Gute Ausstattung: Du erhältst ein Firmen-MacBook und die Software, die du für deine Arbeit brauchst. Hybrides Arbeiten: 3 pro Woche arbeiten wir gemeinsam in unserem Büro nahe Ostkreuz, die übrige Zeit ist flexibel. Remote Work über einen abgestimmten Zeitraum nach Probezeit problemlos möglich. Du hast schon erlebt, wie digitale Projekte in der Realität laufen: mit Kundenwünschen, Abhängigkeiten, technischen Überraschungen und Entscheidungen unter Zeitdruck. Du behältst den Überblick, packst selbst mit an und findest einen gangbaren nächsten Schritt. Dann schick uns: deinen Lebenslauf mit den Projekten, für die du selbst Verantwortung getragen hast zwei bis drei kurze Projektbeispiele mit Ausgangslage, deiner Rolle und Ergebnis mindestens eine Video-Arbeitsprobe ein Beispiel, wie du Claude, Codex oder ein anderes KI-Werkzeug in deiner Arbeit eingesetzt hast Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>ABOUT QUINCE</strong></span></p> <p>Quince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo. Our mission is simple: make really high quality essentials for really low prices, fairly and sustainably. We deliver on that mission through a unique manufacturer-to-consumer (M2C) model eliminating the layers of traditional retail that add cost and result in consumers paying more than they need to. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world’s finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes&nbsp; and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast.</p> <p>What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come – and return – to Quince because they trust us to deliver.</p> <p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>OUR CULTURE</strong></span></p> <p>Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. We aren’t interested in replicating how others do retail. We’re building a better way – at a speed and scale unlike anything that’s been done before.</p> <ul> <li>We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Rejecting long-held assumptions is part of our company's DNA.&nbsp; Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose – soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price – we ask why that trade-off has to exist in the first place.</li> <li>Our pace is fast and the bar is high because our customers expect a lot from us and we refuse to let them down. We believe the best results come from challenging ourselves, learning from one another, and building on each other's strengths.&nbsp;</li> <li>Here, responsibility is not determined by role, tenure, or seniority. Every team member - no matter their level - has the opportunity to drive our business and shape our trajectory.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p>If you’re someone who likes to imagine new possibilities and build better systems rather than plug-in to outdated ones, Quince is the place for you.</p></div><p data-renderer-start-pos="2290" data-local-id="6a0d0d38-3057-4834-9012-12f09f19e465"><strong data-renderer-mark="true"><span class="fabric-text-color-mark" data-renderer-mark="true" data-text-custom-color="#0747a6"><u data-renderer-mark="true">THE ROLE </u></span></strong></p> <p data-renderer-start-pos="2301" data-local-id="6d5afd27-5970-45c1-b675-f5df64663cbf"><strong data-renderer-mark="true"><span class="fabric-text-color-mark" data-renderer-mark="true" data-text-custom-color="#0747a6">Senior Creative Strategist&nbsp;</span></strong></p> <p>The Sr. Creative Strategist for UK/EU is a performance-minded, market-savvy leader who bridges global creative output with the nuances of European consumer behaviour. This person is energized by solving complex business problems, making high-judgment decisions in ambiguous environments, and turning insights into scalable, revenue-driving creative strategy.</p> <p>Success in this role looks like:</p> <ul> <li>Consistently identifying high-performing US creative and adapting it to drive customer acquisition and revenue growth in UK &amp; DE/FR markets</li> <li>Owning the experimentation framework that enables the EU/UK team to move fast, document learnings, and scale winners while maintaining strong alignment with brand identity</li> <li>Serving as the primary creative liaison between UK &amp; DE/FR and cross-functional brand, design, and marketing teams</li> <li>Leveraging data to inform strategic direction</li> <li>This role is critical to establishing Paid Social as a core growth engine in the UK, Germany and France.</li> </ul> <p>This role will be onsite 4-days a week based in London, Madrid, or Berlin.&nbsp;</p> <p data-renderer-start-pos="2663" data-local-id="e0c03b8d-8a8f-42ae-b3e9-26b5a2308ae6"><strong data-renderer-mark="true"><span class="fabric-text-color-mark" data-renderer-mark="true" data-text-custom-color="#0747a6">Responsibilities</span></strong></p> <p><em>Creative Adaptation &amp; Briefing</em></p> <ul> <li>Audit US creative performance regularly to identify high-potential concepts for UK &amp; DE/FR adaptation</li> <li>Brief the US creative team on market-specific adaptation needs; adjusting copy, tone, cultural references, pricing, and product focus for UK &amp; DE/FR audiences</li> <li>Commission net-new creative concepts where US assets are insufficient or market-specific angles are required</li> <li>Write clear, detailed high converting ad briefs for video, static, UGC, and other ad formats with UK &amp; DE/FR market context embedded</li> <li>Ensure all adapted and net-new creative aligns with brand identity while resonating locally</li> <li>Provide strategic feedback to designers and execute on feedback from leadership</li> </ul> <p><em>Experimentation &amp; Performance</em></p> <ul> <li>Build and own a structured experimentation framework for UK &amp; DE/FR paid social; covering hypothesis formation, test design, documentation, and results reporting</li> <li>Prioritise and manage a live test pipeline across Meta (and other channels) to continuously improve creative performance</li> <li>Analyse performance data in Meta Ads Manager, TikTok Ads Manager, and Looker; description: Info: Als AI-Engineer - Dealflow entwickelst und verantwortest du das Produkt bzw. Tool, mit dem wir unseren proprietären Dealflow im Investmentteam im DACH-Software- und Tech-Mittelstand aufbauen. Dein Ziel: Attraktive Unternehmen und ihre Gesellschafter frühzeitig identifizieren und erreichen, idealerweise bevor ein M&A-Berater mandatiert oder ein breiter Verkaufsprozess gestartet wird. Dabei verbindest du zwei Welten: AI-Skills und Deal Origination. Du baust die Daten-, Tool- und Reporting-Infrastruktur, auf der Market Maps, Outbound-Kampagnen und potenzielle Investments und ein skalierbarer Sourcing-Prozess aufsetzen. Du arbeitest eng mit unserem FLEX Leadership Team, dem Investment Team und dem Data & AI Team zusammen und du erhältst vom ersten Tag an viel Ownership für den Aufbau einer zentralen Funktion bei FLEX. Deine Aufgaben Du baust und verantwortest das AI-Produkt/Tool, das unseren Origination-Funnel kontinuierlich mit Software- und Technologieunternehmen im DACH-Mittelstand befüllt. Du entwickelst es laufend weiter und verbesserst es iterativ. Du entwickelst die Screening- und Priorisierungslogik für Targets und verbesserst deren Trefferqualität systematisch. Du baust die automatisierte Datenbeschaffung und -anreicherung aus, sodass Targets angereichert werden mit Firmographics und Eigentümerstrukturen. Du entwickelst Logik und Workflows, um Intent-Signale und potenzielles Verkaufsinteresse zu erkennen. Du initiierst die automatisierte Multichannel-Ansprache und entwickelst die zugrunde liegenden Prozesse weiter. Du baust Dashboards und Reports zu Funnel, Aktivitäten und Conversion als Grundlage unserer Sourcing- und Pipeline-Reviews. Du evaluierst neue Prospecting- und Sourcing-Tools und entwickelst Ansprache, Sequenzen und unsere Messaging-Bibliothek weiter. Dein Profil Du hast eigene Tools und Automatisierungen gebaut, die produktiv im Einsatz waren, nicht nur Prototypen und Demos. Du bringst mindestens 2–3 Jahre Erfahrung im Aufbau AI-basierter Produkte/Tools mit. Du entwickelst selbstständig in Python und deployst mit Docker auf Azure in Produktion. Du kennst LLM-APIs (OpenAI, Claude) aus der Praxis und weißt, wo sie zuverlässig funktionieren und wo (noch) nicht. Du hast bereits Erfahrung im Umgang mit CRM-Daten und weißt, worauf es bei Datenqualität und -struktur ankommt. Kenntnisse in Pipedrive, Agentensystemen sowie Frameworks wie LangGraph sind ein Plus. Du denkst kommerziell: Du verstehst, warum ein Target relevant ist und misst dich an Ergebnissen. Du hast ein Studium in Wirtschaftsinformatik, Data Science, Data Analytics, Informatik oder einem vergleichbaren MINT-Fach erfolgreich abgeschlossen. Du sprichst verhandlungssicher Deutsch und Englisch. Benefits Raum zum Wachsen und die Möglichkeit, viel Verantwortung zu übernehmen, kombiniert mit halbjährlichem Feedback und einem individuellen Weiterbildungsbudget. Persönliche und berufliche Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten durch ein inspirierendes und dynamisches Umfeld und flache Hierarchien. Regelmäßige Events, ein gemeinsamer Sommerurlaub sowie verschiedene Gesundheitsangebote wie beispielsweise zweimonatliche Massage / Physiotherapie im Büro. Moderne und ergonomische Arbeitsmittel, ein Office im Herzen Berlins direkt am Park am Gleisdreieck sowie eine voll ausgestattete Küche mit gesunden Snacks, Softdrinks und einem monatlichen Friday Beer/Sekt/Wein. Ein attraktives Gehaltspaket inklusive Möglichkeiten zur Brutto-Netto-Optimierung. Über uns FLEX Capital ist ein Private Equity Fonds, der sich auf Wachstums- und Buy-out-Möglichkeiten im deutschen Software- und Tech-Mittelstand fokussiert. Hinter FLEX Capital stehen sechs Seriengründer, die mehrfach marktführende Unternehmen mit internationaler Geschäftstätigkeit aufgebaut haben. Auf dieser Basis teilt das FLEX-Team seine Erfahrungen mit Unternehmern und Management Teams, unterstützt sie Hands-on und hilft ihnen so, die gemeinsamen Ziele zu erreichen. Kontakt Join us! title: Teamleiter (m/w/d) Produktionscontrolling
description: Ihre neue Herausforderung als Teamleiter (m/w/d) Produktionscontrolling Sie kennen die Zahlen hinter einer Produktion und möchten künftig nicht nur analysieren, was passiert ist, sondern gemeinsam mit Ihrem Team mitgestalten, was als Nächstes kommt? Dann könnte diese Position gut zu Ihnen passen. Als erfahrene:r Produktionscontroller (m/w/d) übernehmen Sie die fachliche Verantwortung für ein kleines, erfahrenes Team und bleiben gleichzeitig nah am operativen Tagesgeschäft. Ihr fachliches Know-how ist bei uns ebenso gefragt wie Ihre Fähigkeit, Aufgaben zu strukturieren, Prioritäten zu setzen und die unterschiedlichen Stärken im Team zusammenzubringen. Unser Produktionscontrolling ist eng mit den Abläufen unserer Produktionsstandorte verzahnt. SAP bildet dabei das Herzstück unserer täglichen Arbeit und die zentrale Datenbasis für Abrechnung, Kalkulation und Analyse. Gemeinsam mit Ihrem Team möchten wir unsere Prozesse kontinuierlich weiterentwickeln und die Möglichkeiten von Digitalisierung und Automatisierung noch stärker nutzen. Sie schauen gemeinsam, wo neue Lösungen einen echten Mehrwert schaffen, Abläufe erleichtern und mehr Raum für die analytischen Aufgaben des Controllings ermöglichen. Folgende Aufgaben erwarten Sie an unserem Standort in Hamburg-Wilhelmsburg: Sie übernehmen die fachliche Führung und Weiterentwicklung unseres kleinen Teams im Produktionscontrolling, koordinieren Aufgaben und sorgen gemeinsam für verlässliche Abläufe im Tagesgeschäft. Sie verantworten die Abrechnung unserer Produktionsaufträge für die Abpackbetriebe der CAFEA-Gruppe, analysieren die Ergebnisse und arbeiten dabei eng mit unseren Produktionsstandorten zusammen. Sie behalten Herstellkosten, Bestände sowie die Auftrags- und Kostenstellenrechnung im Blick und stellen gemeinsam mit den relevanten Schnittstellen eine verlässliche Datenbasis in SAP sicher. Sie verantworten Kalkulationsläufe sowie relevante Sonderauswertungen und interne Kalkulationen und leiten aus den Ergebnissen die passenden Fragestellungen und Handlungsbedarfe ab. Gemeinsam mit Ihrem Team entwickeln Sie Prozesse, Auswertungen und unser Berichtswesen weiter und nutzen Digitalisierung und Automatisierung dort, wo sie die tägliche Arbeit sinnvoll unterstützen. Darüber hinaus bringen Sie Ihr Know-How in standortübergreifende CAFEA-Projekte ein und arbeiten mit unterschiedlichen Fachbereichen und internationalen Kolleginnen und Kollegen zusammen. Was Sie mitbringen Sie sind fachlich gerne mittendrin, können gleichzeitig den Überblick behalten und haben Freude daran, Menschen, Zahlen und Prozesse zusammenzubringen? Dann passen Sie möglicherweise ziemlich gut zu uns. Ob Ihr beruflicher Weg über ein betriebswirtschaftliches Studium, eine kaufmännische Ausbildung mit entsprechender Weiterbildung oder über mehrjährige praktische Erfahrung geführt hat, ist für uns dabei weniger entscheidend. Wichtig ist uns, dass Sie über fundierte Erfahrung im Controlling, idealerweise im Produktions- oder Werksumfeld, verfügen und betriebswirtschaftliche Zusammenhänge sicher beurteilen können. Sie haben bereits erste Verantwortung für andere übernommen, beispielsweise als fachliche Führungskraft, Stellvertretung, Projektleitung oder in einem kleinen Team? Perfekt. Sie müssen bei uns keine langjährige Führungskarriere mitbringen. Viel wichtiger ist, dass Sie gerne Verantwortung übernehmen, Orientierung geben, zuhören und Ihr Wissen mit anderen teilen. Unser Angebot Digitalisierung gemeinsam gestalten: Wir möchten die Möglichkeiten neuer Technologien künftig noch stärker für unser Produktionscontrolling nutzen. Dabei setzen wir auf Lösungen, die zu unseren Prozessen und vor allem zu den Menschen passen, die täglich mit ihnen arbeiten. Bei uns erwartet Sie nicht nur ein sicherer Arbeitsplatz, sondern auch eine langfristige Perspektive in einem international tätigen Familienunternehmen. Sie erhalten eine attraktive Vergütung, ergänzt durch Weihnachtsgeld, Urlaubsgeld sowie regelmäßige Gehaltsanpassungen. Wir möchten, dass Sie sich bei uns langfristig wohlfühlen und Ihre Arbeit flexibel gestalten können. Deshalb bieten wir Ihnen moderne Arbeitsbedingungen mit Gleitzeit, flexiblen Arbeitszeiten und der Möglichkeit, bis zu zwei Tage pro Woche mobil zu arbeiten. Gemeinsam wachsen: Wir fördern Ihre persönliche und fachliche Weiterentwicklung durch individuelle Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten und externe Qualifizierungsangebote. Bei uns erhalten Sie Gestaltungsspielraum und die Möglichkeit, Verantwortung für spannende Projekte und Produkte zu übernehmen. Auch außerhalb des Arbeitsplatzes möchten wir etwas zurückgeben: Sie profitieren von Zuschüssen zur betrieblichen Altersvorsorge, JobRad, vermögenswirksamen Leistungen, Deutschlandticket sowie vergünstigten Sport- und Gesundheitsangeboten über machtfit. Karriere mit Geschmack: Sie erhalten monatliche Freikontingente, damit Sie auch nach der Arbeit erstklassigen Kaffee, Cappuccino und Trinkschokoladen genießen können. Damit nicht nur unsere Produkte überzeugen, sondern auch Ihr Arbeitsalltag angenehm bleibt, wird in unserer betriebseigenen Kantine täglich frisch gekocht. Dank unserer Kooperation mit dem Fürstenberg Institut erhalten Sie und Ihre Familienangehörigen Zugang zu professioneller und vertraulicher Beratung – bei beruflichen, privaten oder familiären Themen. Unsere Mitarbeitenden liegen uns am Herzen. Neben den vielfältigen Angeboten gehören auch kleine Aufmerksamkeiten zu Geburtstagen, Ostern, Nikolaus oder Weihnachten bei uns einfach dazu. Dürfen wir uns kurz vorstellen? Familiär. International. Langfristig. Besondere Qualität entsteht, wenn Tradition und Moderne miteinander harmonieren. Wir gehen respektvoll, offen und hilfsbereit miteinander um und geben jeden Tag unser Bestes, um erstklassige Kaffee-Spezialitäten zu produzieren. Bei der DEK arbeiten Sie in einem internationalen Umfeld und spüren zugleich die Vorteile eines inhabergeführten Familienunternehmens. title: Steuerberater und/oder Rechtsanwalt als Gestaltungsberater für Restrukturierung und Unternehmensnachfolge (m/w/d)
description: Die AWP Wirtschaftstreuhand GmbH ist Mitglied des Netzwerkverbunds der LKC, welchem über 30 Kanzleien deutschlandweit angehören. Die gesuchte Person wird deshalb nicht nur für die AWP als Arbeitgeber tätig sein, sondern soll im Rahmen der gesamten LKC-Gruppe ihre fachliche Kompetenz auftrags- und fallbezogen einbringen können. Wer wir sind und was uns ausmacht. Wir in der LKC-Gruppe bieten unseren Mandanten eine ganzheitliche Beratung in allen steuerlichen und betriebswirtschaftlichen Belangen. Als Kanzleiverbund setzen wir dabei auf digitale und effiziente Prozesse und nutzen aktiv die Chancen der Digitalisierung. Damit schaffen wir mehr Zeit für unsere Mandanten und abwechslungsreiche Aufgaben rund um die Gestaltungsberatung. Trotz des Leistungsangebots und Mandaten, wie man sie eher in Großkanzleien findet, kennen wir bei LKC unsere Kollegen persönlich und unterstützen uns gegenseitig mit unseren individuellen Stärken und Kenntnissen. Aufgaben Ihre Aufgaben. Als Gestaltungsberater für Restrukturierung und Unternehmensnachfolge erwartet Sie ein spannendes und herausforderndes Tätigkeitsfeld. Als steuerlicher Experte erarbeiten Sie in engem Austausch mit dem jeweiligen mandatsverantwortlichen Partner individuelle Gestaltungskonzepte und begleiten deren Umsetzung bis zum Abschluss. Maßgeschneiderte Lösungen und Strategien werden von Ihnen entwickelt, um Unternehmen in sensiblen Umstellungsphasen erfolgreich zu begleiten. Sie führen unsere Mandanten durch steuerliche und rechtliche Herausforderungen und unterstützen sie als vertrauensvoller Partner. Hierbei fungieren Sie als standortübergreifender Berater der LKC-Gruppe. Ihren beruflichen Sitz hätten Sie je nach Ihrer privaten und familiären Orientierung in einer unserer Partnerkanzleien in Regensburg (AWP), Augsburg (GRP Günter Reitmayer GmbH & Co. KG) oder München. Ihre Beratungsaufträge werden dabei durch Kanzleien der LKC-Gruppe generiert, sodass Sie auch überregionale Aufträge bearbeiten werden, jedoch mit Schwerpunkt im süddeutschen Raum. In dieser Rolle können Sie Ihre Expertise in einem dynamischen Umfeld einsetzen und sich kontinuierlich weiterentwickeln. Unter anderem erwarten Sie folgende Tätigkeiten: Erstellung und operative Umsetzung von Umwandlungen, Restrukturierungen sowie der Nachfolgeberatung Steuerrechtliche Beratung bei der Unternehmensnachfolge und Begleitung bei der Ausarbeitung der erforderlichen Verträge und weiteren rechtlichen Maßnahmen Erstellung von Gutachten und Stellungnahmen Qualifikation Ihr Profil. Sie sind ein Teamplayer und finden sich in folgenden Punkten wieder? Dann freuen wir uns, Sie bei der LKC willkommen zu heißen. About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $11B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

We're looking for a Data Scientist to take ownership of the datasets and evaluation workflows that underpin our AI Safety work. You'll turn real-world product data into reliable, well-structured datasets for training and evaluating models, and help build the processes and infrastructure to continuously assess how those models perform in production.

This is a hands-on role at the intersection of data science, ML, AI safety, and policy. You'll work closely with safety researchers, engineers, and policy specialists to translate complex safety requirements into practical data and evaluation systems - starting hands-on with collection, analysis, and labelling, then building the methodologies, contributor networks, and quality standards that let this work scale.

In this role, you will

  • Own safety datasets end-to-end: collection, cleaning, labelling, quality control, versioning, and readiness for training and evaluation.

  • Translate safety policy into clear, consistent labelling and evaluation criteria, working closely with policy specialists.

  • Design and manage labelling processes, including sourcing, onboarding, and overseeing external contributors to a high quality bar.

  • Build evaluation workflows for models in production, using real-world data to track performance and surface issues.

  • Develop lightweight Python/SQL pipelines and tooling to make data work faster and reproducible, partnering with ML engineers on what "training-ready" looks like.

Who you are

  • Experience as a Data Scientist, or similar, working with real-world datasets and ML models.

  • Strong grasp of what makes a good dataset: collection, cleaning, sampling, labelling, quality control, evaluation.

  • Comfortable with Python and SQL for analysis and practical data workflows.

  • Strong critical thinking and judgement - comfortable with ambiguity and nuance, and able to turn complex guidelines into consistent, scalable decisions.

  • Autonomous and a clear communicator, able to work across disciplines (policy, engineering, research) in a fast-moving, still-forming environment.

Bonus points

  • Experience in AI safety, trust & safety, content moderation, or fraud/abuse detection.

  • Experience building datasets or evaluation frameworks, or with adversarial/safety-focused ML.

  • Experience managing human-in-the-loop labelling processes, dataset versioning, or ML pipeline tooling.

  • Experience operationalising guidelines with policy or legal teams.

Location

This role is based in London, where you'll work closely with our AI Safety and Policy teams.

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

Attributes&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>• &nbsp; &nbsp;Highly organised and proactive, with the ability to take ownership of multiple workstreams and maintain momentum without constant direction.&nbsp;<br>• &nbsp; &nbsp;An understanding of how consistent campaign data supports reliable reporting, measurement and operational efficiency.&nbsp;<br>• &nbsp; &nbsp;Experience coaching junior colleagues or coordinating contributors supporting a wider workstream.&nbsp;</p> <p>Measures of Success&nbsp;<br>• &nbsp; They are looking for a proactive and technically capable engineer who is comfortable working directly with customers, resolving technical issues and supporting IT environments both remotely and on customer premises.

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide technical assistance to customers and act as a trusted point of contact for support matters.

  • Visit customer sites to investigate and resolve technical issues, perform installations and undertake planned maintenance.

  • Manage incidents, requests and ongoing technical tasks through the Service Desk system.

  • Provide customers with regular updates and ensure tickets are progressed within agreed SLAs.

  • Escalate critical, complex or high-priority issues to Management when appropriate.

  • Organise daily workloads and ensure urgent and important tasks are dealt with accordingly.

  • Monitor customer environments and infrastructure to ensure systems remain reliable and meet business requirements.

  • Install, configure, test, maintain and repair IT hardware, software and related systems.

  • Maintain accurate ticket information and document technical work and outstanding actions.

  • Respond to major incidents and priority issues both remotely and at customer locations.

Benefits

  • £30,000 - £40,000 per annum, depending on experience.

  • 40 days' paid holiday annually.


The ideal candidate will have a minimum of 5 years' experience in a similar IT engineering role, with practical knowledge of:

  • Cyber Essentials and GDPR security standards, including configuration and implementation (mandatory).

  • Microsoft 365 services, including Email, SharePoint, Teams and OneDrive (mandatory).

  • Microsoft Intune, RMM solutions and telephone platforms.

  • Network infrastructure installation and support, including routers, switches, wireless APs, DHCP, DNS, TCP/IP, firewalls and VLANs.

  • Working with external suppliers and service providers to resolve technical requirements.

  • Applying appropriate IT procedures, controls and industry best practices.

  • Windows Server 2016, 2019 and 2022, including Group Policy and security policies.

  • Azure administration and implementation.

  • Windows 10, Windows 11 and Mac operating systems.

  • Building, imaging and configuring different customer environments.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills and a professional customer-facing manner.

  • The ability to analyse issues, troubleshoot effectively and work independently.

  • A collaborative approach and the ability to contribute as part of a wider team.

Reporting directly to the Senior Director, International Product, this senior individual contributor role is responsible for executing feature roadmaps, localising core capabilities for target markets, and streamlining platform integration. Product Analytics: Familiarity with telemetry and reporting tools (e.g. Tableau, Sigma) to track user behaviour and feature success. Leadership Experience: Proven track record of leading cross-functional project teams and delivering complex feature rollouts without direct managerial authority. Stakeholder Alignment: Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to convey product roadmaps and technical requirements effectively to cross-functional peers and leadership. Analytical & Business Judgment: Strong business judgment with a data-driven approach to solving operational and technical challenges. We use trusted AI to detect and prevent financial crime, fraud, and money laundering at scale: the world's top banks, payment networks, and acquirers trust our technology to safeguard more than one billion consumers and $9 trillion in payment volume every year.&nbsp;</p> <p>Feedzai is a Series D company and has raised $282M to date. With a valuation of $2 billion, our technology protects 1 billion consumers and 90 billion transactions each year.</p></div><p style="text-align: justify;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>The Marketing Team</strong> is empowered to spark change daily with MAP - Mastery in their role, Autonomy to make decisions, and a Purpose to make the world a safer place for all consumers. You’re a natural orchestrator who can build alignment, drive accountability and confidently communicate with senior stakeholders. You stay close to performance, know how to spot what isn’t working, and bring the right teams together to fix it.</span></p> <h3 style="text-align: justify;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>Your Day to Day:</strong></span></h3> <p>&nbsp;</p> <ul style="text-align: justify;"> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Design and lead multi-channel, full-funnel campaigns tied to Feedzai’s strategic GTM motions and growth priorities.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Translate business priorities into clear campaign goals, audiences, messaging, buyer journeys, routes to market and success metrics.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Orchestrate teams across Product Marketing, Digital, Content, Comms, Creative, Regional Marketing, Partner Marketing, ADRs and Sales to deliver against one integrated campaign strategy.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Identify critical gaps in audience, market intelligence, positioning, product readiness or sales follow-up and work with the right stakeholders to resolve them.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Partner with Product Marketing to translate positioning, buyer insights and product priorities into differentiated full-funnel messaging.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Stay close to campaign, lead and pipeline performance, working with Digital, ADRs and Sales to quickly identify issues and optimize messaging, targeting, channels and follow-up.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Build campaign enablement that gives Sales and ADR teams the messaging, content and outreach guidance needed to convert engagement and accelerate pipeline.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Lead campaign reviews, clearly communicating performance, learnings, risks, recommendations and next steps.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Manage multiple complex campaigns at once, bringing structure, accountability and momentum in a fast-moving environment.</span></li> </ul> <h3 style="text-align: justify;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>You Have &amp; You Know‑How:</strong></span></h3> <p>&nbsp;</p> <ul> <li style="font-size: 12pt; text-align: justify;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">8–10+ years of B2B marketing experience, with significant experience leading integrated or demand generation campaigns in SaaS, fintech or enterprise technology.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt; text-align: justify;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Proven ability to translate business priorities into clear, measurable full-funnel campaign strategies that drive pipeline and revenue impact.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt; text-align: justify;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Deep understanding of B2B marketing fundamentals, including audience segmentation, ICPs, positioning, buyer journeys, demand generation and pipeline acceleration.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt; text-align: justify;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Exceptional cross-functional leadership and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to build alignment and drive execution across teams you do not directly manage.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt; text-align: justify;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Strong project and program management skills, with the ability to juggle multiple complex initiatives, teams and deadlines.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt; text-align: justify;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Strong executive presence and communication skills, with the confidence to clearly articulate strategy, recommendations and performance to senior leaders.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt; text-align: justify;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">A data-driven mindset, comfortable analyzing campaign and pipeline performance and translating insights into action.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt; text-align: justify;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Strong marketing judgment, with the ability to identify missing inputs, ask the right questions and keep work moving forward.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt; text-align: justify;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">A self-starter with a bias for action who thrives in high-pressure environments where priorities can change and complete information may not always be available.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt; text-align: justify;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Experience in B2B SaaS, fintech, fraud, financial crime, payments, banking technology title: Senior Product Manager - Athlete Performance
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>At Hudl, we build great teams. We hire the best of the best to ensure you’re working with people you can constantly learn from. You’re trusted to get your work done your way while testing the limits of what’s possible and what’s next. We work hard to provide a culture where everyone feels supported, and our employees feel it—their votes helped us become one of <a href="https://www.hudl.com/blog/newsweek-top-100-global-most-loved-workplaces-2023">Newsweek's Top 100 Global Most Loved Workplaces</a>.&nbsp;&nbsp;<br><br>We think of ourselves as the team behind the team, supporting the lifelong impact sports can have: the lessons in teamwork and dedication; the influence of inspiring coaches; and the opportunities to reach new heights. That’s why we help teams from all over the world see their game differently. Our products make it easier for coaches and athletes at any level to capture video, analyze data, share highlights and more.<br><br>Ready to join us?</p> <div style="padding: 56.25% 0 0 0; position: relative;"><iframe style="position: absolute; top: 0; left: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; border: 0;" src="https://player.vimeo.com/video/1095624224?h=9e8cdc9dbe&amp;badge=0&amp;autopause=0&amp;player_id=0&amp;app_id=58479" width="" height=""></iframe></div> <p>&nbsp;</p></div><h2>Your Role</h2> <p>We’re looking for a <strong>Senior Product Manager</strong> to join our Athlete Performance group. You’ll be responsible for a product suite that supports sports scientists and coaches in capturing and analysing athlete monitoring data—whether from wearables, optical tracking, or other data sources—to mitigate injury risk, optimise athletic performance, and track the physical development of athletes.&nbsp;</p> <p>As a <strong>Senior Product Manager</strong>, you’ll:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Grow our human performance business</strong>. You’ll work with a cross-functional team to create a coherent product strategy and vision, connecting it to the wider company strategy and effectively delivering against it. You’ll “quarterback” a key investment, with the goal of building products that customers love and use daily.</li> <li><strong>Advocate for the product.</strong> You’ll develop a deep understanding of our customers and our business needs, building trusting relationships with customers and senior internal stakeholders. You’ll also help practitioners tell a fully contextualised story by combining athlete monitoring data with Hudl’s unique video and match analysis assets.</li> <li><strong>Motivate your squad</strong>. This is critical—you’ll determine what success looks like and work across multiple functions to turn your product vision to reality.</li> <li><strong>Foster collaboration.</strong> While balancing cost, timeline and customer benefit, you’ll also work with Marketing, Sales and Customer Support to develop go-to-market plans.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Time spent collaborating with your teammates in-office will be a regular part of how you work. We’re currently considering applicants within commuting distance of London. You’ll be expected to work more days in-office than remote, but will have&nbsp; the freedom to coordinate your specific in-office schedule with your team.</strong></p> <h2>Must-Haves</h2> <ul> <li><strong>Experience</strong>. You’ve spent more than four years in product management roles within agile software development environments. You can work largely autonomously, and you have a proven track record of delivering valuable customer-facing software.&nbsp;</li> <li><strong>Dependable.</strong> You can be counted on to find the right information to make a decision, and you own them after they’re made.&nbsp;&nbsp;</li> <li><strong>Grit. </strong>You don’t let setbacks get you down—instead, you come through and deliver for customers.</li> <li><strong>A self-starter.</strong> You can balance your time between working with your squad, running discovery and defining strategy. You also know how to get the job done and can roll up your sleeves and get hands on when necessary.</li> <li><strong>AI-native.</strong> You leverage AI tools and workflows to accelerate discovery, sharpen decision-making, enhance communication, and increase delivery velocity. You know how to use AI to prototype ideas quickly, synthesize insights from data and customer feedback, and improve both product strategy and execution while maintaining strong judgment and ownership.</li> <li><strong>A communicator. </strong>You’re comfortable presenting, writing strategic documents, and sharing your product roadmap with stakeholders. You can decompose complex problems to bring senior leaders along, gain buy-in for your ideas, and motivate others toward a common goal.</li> <li><strong>Commercially-minded.</strong> You have good business sense and know how to balance user needs with business goals.</li> <li><strong>Naturally curious.</strong> You never stop learning—you’re eager for knowledge and new ideas because that improves the way you work. You love building prototypes, testing, learning and evolving.</li> <li><strong>Data-driven</strong>. You have a passion for using data and insights to drive high quality decision-making, but also know when to take calculated leaps of faith.&nbsp;</li> <li><strong>A proven people leader</strong>. You care deeply about your team and want to help them be successful.&nbsp;</li> <li><strong>Collaborative.</strong> You’re comfortable working with other teams, seek to understand the strengths of those around you, and have made each team you’ve worked on better. You relish tackling hard problems alongside your squad and building great relationships with teams.</li> </ul> <h2>Nice-to-Haves</h2> <ul> <li><strong>Domain experience. </strong>If you’ve worked in the sports technology industry, or have experience in wearables, athlete tracking technologies, and the associated software, that’s a plus.</li> <li><strong>Sports science background. </strong>You have hands-on experience as a sports scientist and you bring deep industry context, along with a strong network of professional connections.</li> <li><strong>Innovation.</strong> You’ve successfully brought “0 to 1” product initiatives to life, turning concepts into real, impactful solutions.</li> </ul> <h2>Our Role</h2> <ul> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><strong>Champion work-life harmony</strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">. We’ll give you the flexibility you need in your work life (e.g., flexible vacation time, company-wide holidays and timeout (meeting-free) days, remote work options and more) so you can enjoy your personal life too.</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><strong>Guarantee autonomy</strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">. We have an open, honest culture and we trust our people from day one. Your team will support you, but you’ll own your work and have the agency to try new ideas.&nbsp;</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><strong>Encourage career growth</strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">. We’re lifelong learners who encourage professional development. We’ll give you tons of resources and opportunities to keep growing.</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><strong>Provide an environment to help you succeed</strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">. We've invested in our offices, designing incredible spaces with our employees in mind. But whether you’re at the office or working remotely, we’ll provide you the tech stack and hardware to do your best work.</span></li> <li><strong>Support your wellbeing. </strong>Depending on location, we offer medical and retirement benefits for employees—but no matter where you’re located, we have resources like our Employee Assistance Program and employee resource groups to support your mental health.</li> </ul> <h2>Compensation</h2><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p>The base salary range for this role is displayed below—<strong>starting salaries will typically fall near the middle of this range.</strong></p> <p>We make compensation decisions based on an individual's experience, skills and education in line with our internal pay equity practices.&nbsp;</p> <p>This role will also be eligible for a long-term incentive (LTI) award. Any bonuses awarded are based on individual and company performance paid at Hudl's discretion.&nbsp;</p></div><div class="title">Base Salary Range</div><div class="pay-range"><span>£66,000</span><span class="divider">&mdash;</span><span>£111,000 GBP</span></div></div></div><div class="content-conclusion"><h2><strong>Inclusion at Hudl&nbsp;</strong></h2> <p>Hudl is an equal opportunity employer. Through our actions, behaviors and attitude, we’ll create an environment where everyone, no matter their differences, feels like they belong.&nbsp;<br><br>We offer resources to ensure our employees feel safe bringing their authentic selves to work, <a href="https://www.hudl.com/about-inclusion" target="_blank">including employee resource groups and communities</a>. But we recognize there’s ongoing work to be done, which is why we track our efforts and commitments in <a href="https://www.hudl.com/about-inclusion" target="_blank">annual inclusion reports</a>.&nbsp;<br><br><span style="font-weight: 400;">We also know imposter syndrome is real and the <a href="https://www.theatlantic.com/magazine/archive/2014/05/the-confidence-gap/359815/" target="_blank">confidence gap</a> can get in the way of meeting spectacular candidates. Please don’t hesitate to apply—we’d love to hear from you.</span></p> <h2><strong>Privacy Policy</strong></h2> <p><strong><a href="https://www.hudl.com/jobs/hudl-applicant-and-candidate-privacy-policy"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Hudl Applicant and Candidate Privacy Policy</span></a><br><br></strong></p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

description: <p>At Too Good To Go, we have an ambitious goal: to inspire and empower everyone to fight food waste together.</p> <p>40% of all food produced in the world is wasted. And that has a huge impact on the health of our planet, with 10% of greenhouse gas emissions coming from food waste.</p> <p>We’re more than an app: we are a certified B Corporation with a mission to empower everyone to take action against food waste, so alongside our marketplace app, we create educational tools, explore new business solutions - such as our Retail Technologies offering, and influence legislation to help reduce food waste.</p> <h4>We’re growing fast: Our community of 127 million registered users and 253,000 active partners across 20 countries, have together already prevented 489+ million meals from going to waste - avoiding over 1.322.000 tonnes of CO2e!</h4> <h3><strong>The Role</strong></h3> <p>We are building a brand-new engineering hub in London, and we are looking for <strong>foundational Frontend Software Engineers</strong> to help us kick it off. This is a unique opportunity: you will be joining a completely new team, building a new hub from scratch, and working remotely from the rest of our global Tech organisation.</p> <p>As an integral part of this new product team, you will help define, build, and deliver our product features. You will work towards specific outcomes with the freedom and responsibility to figure out the best way to achieve them together with your team. Your mission will be to help refine, design, implement, deliver, and maintain an international top-class product, ensuring quality, maintainability, and sustainability.</p> <h3><strong>The Tech Stack</strong></h3> <p>We have created a single-page React application localized into multiple languages with TypeScript, RTK Query, MUI, and react-router. Developers typically run the SPA locally with Vite or Webpack DevServer (including hot module replacement) against endpoints on test servers.</p> <h3><strong>Responsibilities</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Build and evolve our frontend applications and user-facing infrastructure to stay ahead of our growth curve.</li> <li>Develop exciting new features for our customers, partner businesses, and internal systems to improve usability and operational efficiency.</li> <li>Implement responsive, reliable, and intuitive visual elements and interactive workflows across web applications.</li>   • Incident response — Own all security incidents from detection through resolution and post-mortem; maintain and improve the incident response plan

  • Access governance — Run quarterly access reviews across all systems; ensure least-privilege principles are enforced

  • Internal advisory — Field "Can I use this?" questions from employees evaluating new tools, vendors, and workflows

  • AI governance — Define and maintain guardrails for internal AI use, balancing productivity with data protection

  • Security exercises — Plan and execute tabletop exercises, simulated incidents, and red/purple team engagements

  • DLP & insider threat — Oversee the data loss prevention program, triage alerts, and refine policies

  • Vendor security — Review third-party vendor security posture and manage the vendor risk assessment process

  • Security awareness — Maintain the employee security training program and foster a security-conscious culture

  • Infrastructure security partnership — Collaborate with Platform Engineering on cloud security posture (AWS), container security, and vulnerability management

Requirements

  • 5+ years of experience in information security, with at least 2 years in a senior or leadership role

  • 2+ years hands-on experience in a DevOps or Platform Engineering role

  • Proficiency with AI tools like Claude Code

  • Deep familiarity with compliance frameworks (SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, CCPA)

  • Experience owning incident response end-to-end in a SaaS or cloud-native environment

  • Comfortable in customer-facing settings — you can clearly articulate security posture to enterprise prospects

  • Hands-on experience with identity management (Okta or similar), MDM, DLP, and cloud security tooling

  • Strong understanding of application security in a modern stack

  • Real consultative selling instinct: you'd rather understand a prospect's problem than run a script at them.

  • Comfortable prospecting and selling into accounts with little existing awareness of Cytix, energised by the challenge of a cold or lightly-worked start.

  • Visible drive and competitiveness, and a willingness to take on unfamiliar deal types or buyer personas when asked.

  • Genuinely bright and inquisitive: good follow-up questions come naturally to you, and you're genuinely curious about the product and the security market, including how software gets built and secured.

  • Drawn to a business where new challenges show up daily; you want to take ownership of them and lean in, rather than needing everything mapped out in advance.

  • Comfortable taking yourself out of your comfort zone when a deal or a buyer is unfamiliar territory.

What you'll get

  • Unlimited Holidays!

  • Share options - If Cytix wins, you should too.

  • Enhanced maternity pay.

  • Pension - 8% (3% employer, 5% employee)

  • Private Healthcare (inc. dental, optical and hearing)

  • Octopus car scheme - Drive electric through salary sacrifice

  • Inclusivity as standard - A team where you can do your best work as yourself, no asterisks.

About Cytix

Software never stops changing. Teams ship new code every day, through tickets, pull requests, releases, and increasingly with AI in the mix, but the way security keeps up with all that change hasn't really moved on.

That's the problem we're solving. Cytix helps organisations understand which software changes actually matter, what should happen next, and how to prove the right call was made. Security understood, in other words.

Find the smarter path. You ask why before how. You dig into what the real problem is instead of just building what the spec says, and you're happy to question 'that's how it's always been done' when the reason behind it has gone stale.

See it through. When something's yours, it lands. No loose ends, no surprises for whoever picks it up next. You keep people posted when things change, and if something falls between roles, you catch it.

Raise the bar. You do the best job possible in the time you've got, whether that's a day or a month. Sometimes that means deep craft; sometimes the smartest move is quick and scrappy. It's about good judgement, and we hold each other to it without blame or politics.

Play to win. You care about the mission but don't take yourself too seriously. You say 'I' when things go wrong and 'we' when they go right, trust teammates to do things their own way, and bring a bit of humour when the pressure's on.

Right now, our platform connects nearly one million assets worldwide, putting over 6GW of live load under our direct control. Behind the scenes, that means handling massive technical scale: solving complex optimization problems in real time and processing 15 billion data readings a day from the latest green technologies, ensuring the grid stays reliable without relying on old fossil-fuel backup plants. The next phase of our journey involves monumental growth. Our mission is to integrate an increasingly diverse array of green flexibility assets while ensuring our market-leading platform remains exceptionally stable and performant. While other chapters manage physical asset connectivity or ingest market signals, this domain is responsible for the intelligence that decides exactly what every asset should do, second by second, to maximise both grid stability and financial returns. The teams within this chapter build and maintain the real-time dispatch engines, predictive forecasting models, and algorithmic solvers that handle massive multi-asset portfolios. Ultimately, this chapter must move away from bespoke optimisation routines tailored to individual markets or asset types. These include our flagship Intelligent Octopus product automating demand shift for 300,000 customers with electric cars, home batteries or smart heating devices, saving 2 million customers money through Saving Sessions and Free Electricity Sessions, and managing 568MW of large grid-scale batteries to balance the system. We embrace flat hierarchies and an open, agile culture that fosters innovation, flexibility, and creativity. 

We don’t hang our personalities up with our coats and nor should you. At Octopus, we hire great people who get stuff done, all whilst being themselves.

If this sounds exciting, we’d love to chat.

  • Acting as the flexibility team’s first frontend engineer, establish the team’s frontend capability, lead the team’s frontend technical direction and represent the team to the cross-team community of frontend engineers

  • Build and own a diverse range of customer-facing user journeys, enabling customers to onboard, control, and analyse their low carbon tech

  • Build and own internal-facing interfaces for stakeholder-collaborators and experimental prototypes

  • Interface with established mobile teams by providing WebViews for emerging mobile customer journeys 

  • Collaborate with our internal design team to integrate our designs into the wider Octopus design system ‘Coral’

  • Carry out product discovery by working closely with our Product Manager and stakeholders from across the organisation

  • Build highly reusable interfaces that enable rapid response to new opportunities

  • 5+ years of experience with our stack (listed below)

  • Confidence tackling large-scale tasks individually

  • React (required)

title: Senior Fire Investigator - Ireland
description: <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Company Overview</strong></p> <p>Throughout our worldwide network of experts, clients and communities, we are renowned for our leadership in fire protection engineering – a legacy of responsibility we have proudly upheld since 1939. Today, our expertise extends broadly across closely related security and risk-based fields – from accessibility consulting and risk analysis to process safety, forensic investigations, security risk consulting, emergency management, digital innovation and more.</p> <p>Our engineers and consultants collaborate to solve complex safety and security challenges, ensuring our clients can protect what matters most. For over 80 years, we have helped mitigate risks that threaten lives, property and reputations. Through technology, expertise and industry-leading research, we remain dedicated to our purpose of making our world safe, secure and resilient.</p> <p>At Jensen Hughes, we believe that creating and sustaining a culture of trust, integrity and professional growth starts with putting our people first. Our employees are our greatest strength, and we value the unique perspectives and talents they bring to our organization.&nbsp;</p> <p>Our wide range of Global Employee Networks connect people from across the organization, supporting career development and providing forums for individuals to share experiences on topics they're passionate about. Together, we are cultivating a connected culture where everyone has the opportunity to learn, grow and succeed together.</p> <p><strong>Job Overview</strong></p> <p>Jensen Hughes is a market leading forensic investigation company, comprised of highly experienced investigators committed to delivering technical excellence.&nbsp; Operating throughout the UK, Ireland and overseas, we investigate the origin and cause of fires and explosions and other accidents or failures on land and at sea. Our clients trust us to respond rapidly and deliver conclusive reports, robust evidence and expert testimony of the highest technical standard in courts throughout the world.</p> <p>A forensic investigation includes establishing the root cause of an event and determining the likelihood of a recovery from a third party or the repudiation of a claim on an insurance policy because the policyholder has failed to fulfil obligations under the contract of insurance.</p> <p><strong>Responsibilities</strong></p> <p>An exciting opportunity has arisen for a Senior Fire Investigator to join our highly qualified team, based in Ireland.</p> <p>&nbsp;This role will involve:</p> <ul> <li>Attending incident scenes, documenting and collecting evidence, interviewing witnesses</li> <li>Acting as investigator in the investigation of the origin, cause and development of more complex cases</li> <li>Liaising with experts representing other interested parties</li> <li>Producing consistently high quality, detailed and accurate technical reports</li> <li>Providing expert witness evidence, where required</li> <li>Utilising Jensen Hughes’ case management system to record all case-related activity, in line with SLA requirements</li> <li>Attending joint examinations, utilising the skills of specialists where necessary</li> <li>Maintaining technical knowledge and skills through continuous professional development, by attending training courses, undertaking research and reference to scientific papers and developments in the field of fire and explosion investigation</li> <li>Attending marketing events, as required</li> <li>Produce and present articles/presentations for training or marketing purposes</li> <li>Represent Jensen Hughes at meetings/conferences as an ambassador for the company</li> </ul> <p><strong>Requirements and Qualifications</strong></p> <ul> <li>Candidates will have relevant experience and/or qualifications in the field of fire investigation, fire engineering, forensic science or other relevant discipline. Membership to a professional body would be advantageous but is not essential. Regardless of academic/professional background, practical experience is essential.</li> <li>The role requires strong analytical skills and the ability to apply scientific and systematic approaches to the forensic examination of incident scenes.</li> <li>Strong communication skills are essential, along with the ability to present accurate information in a clear and unambiguous manner, both verbally and in writing.&nbsp; Attention to detail, a flexible approach and an ability to form effective working relationships with colleagues and clients are key qualities for this position. You will be expected to be able to work independently with minimal supervision, albeit there will always be a support network of colleagues when assistance or guidance is required.</li> <li>This role requires frequent, often short notice, travel to scenes across Ireland and the UK. Some overseas travel may also be required. You must hold a current driving licence and, ideally, be a car owner.</li> </ul> <p>In return, we offer a competitive salary and performance-related bonus along with other benefits.&nbsp;</p> <p>#LI-MR1</p> <p>&nbsp;</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><em><strong>Jensen Hughes is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status.</strong></em></p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>At Jensen Hughes, we embrace innovation and understand that people are increasingly using artificial intelligence (AI) tools like ChatGPT and other generative platforms to learn, prepare and communicate.&nbsp; We have provided some guidelines regarding the responsible use of AI in the recruitment process.&nbsp; Please click <strong><a href="https://www.jensenhughes.com/careers/responsible-use-of-ai-in-the-jensen-hughes-recruitment-process">here</a></strong> to review.</p> <p><br>The security of your personal data is important to us. Jensen Hughes has implemented reasonable physical, technical, and administrative security standards to protect personal data from loss, misuse, alteration, or destruction. We protect your personal data against unauthorized access, use, or disclosure, using security technologies and procedures, such as encryption and limited access. Only authorized individuals may access your personal data for the purpose for which it was collected, and these individuals receive training about the importance of protecting personal data.&nbsp; Jensen Hughes is committed to compliance with all relevant data privacy laws in all areas where we do business, including, but not limited to, the GDPR and the CCPA.&nbsp; Additionally, our service providers are contractually bound to maintain the confidentiality of personal data and may not use the information for any unauthorized purpose.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>*Policy on use of 3rd party recruiting agency for direct placements<br><br>Jensen Hughes will occasionally augment a recruiting search through agencies for certain positions when business conditions warrant. Jensen Hughes will not accept resumes, inquiries or proposals from recruiting agencies as an acceptable method to consider a candidate. 3rd party recruiting agencies must sign a standard Jensen Hughes agreement after being evaluated and accepted by a Human Resources or Talent Acquisition manager, or member of the talent acquisition team. Hiring managers and employees of Jensen Hughes are not authorized to accept resumes, engage in fee-based searches through recruiting firms or sign a search agreement. Please note this policy does not apply to “staffing firms” or firms that are involved with hiring temporary staff. Any recruiting agency interested in being considered may contact our recruiting team at jensenhughesrecruiting.com.</p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

client expectations.</li> <li>Providing in-house CPD presentations when the need arises in your specialist field.</li> <li>Keeping updated with the latest industry guidance, product literature and overnight stays sometimes required.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Requirements and Qualifications</strong></p> <ul> <li>Degree educated in Building Surveying, Fire Safety Management or other similar discipline.</li> <li>Full UK driving licence and access to your own private vehicle.</li> <li>Understanding of fire safety design and guidance for different building types.</li> <li>Experience undertaking fire compartmentation surveys for internal fire stopping installations and advising the contractor based on the relevant manufacturer's literature.</li> <li>The ability to author in depth technical reports utilising the information obtained during the site inspection using both bespoke digital fire protection software and Microsoft Word.</li> <li>The ability to input survey data   • Oversee studio-level production budgets — including cost estimation, supplier relationships, and spend reporting — ensuring financial performance aligns with Client and OLIVER expectations
  • Drive responsible integration of AI tools across studio workflows, setting quality standards and governance that preserve craft excellence while improving efficiency 

What you need to be great in this role: 

  • A strong portfolio of sophisticated brand and campaign work, with particular depth in B2B, corporate, or professional services environments
  • Expert-level understanding of brand systems — how to build, maintain, and evolve them within complex, regulated contexts
  • A track record of leading and developing creative teams, with a coaching approach that brings out the best in people at all levels

Why Lovable?

Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we're just getting started.

We're building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.

Lovable is one of TIME's 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe's fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software.

What we're looking for

  • 5+ years in content design or UX writing, with a portfolio that shows work on both sides: copy shipped inside a product, and marketing pages you wrote or restructured

  • Real in-product examples. Onboarding flows, empty states, error messaging, upgrade moments - the words people hit when something is confusing or has gone wrong. Tell us what changed as a result
